name: 루치아
motion_summary: Eternal Return Lucia Musketeer's Etiquette: long silver-white curled hair, refined cool blue eyes and composed small mouth, aristocratic white/violet-black outfit and thin elegant firearm exactly as identity. R is one powerful straight shot, removes and reapplies crystal on hit. Exact 12 poses: ready; turn torso three-quarter right; raise ornate long-barrel gun; feet brace; support hand steadies barrel; violet/white crystal light condenses at muzzle; aim hold; single powerful violet-white straight shot with crystalline shards extending right; shoulder and hair recoil backward; thin crystal shards reform near muzzle; lower gun gracefully; ready. NOT swords/portals/magic staff, NOT floating generic aura. Face uncovered; angular violet/lavender shot contrast against white hair. Target does not need depicted enemy. IMPORTANT FIX: Make ALL artwork 20% smaller WITHIN every square cell, leaving the outside 15% fully transparent. The shot in frame8 MUST BE A SHORT FINITE CRYSTAL PROJECTILE WITH A VISIBLE POINTED TIP, NOT a long light beam going out of frame. Its full length from muzzle to pointed tip must remain inside the central 70% of the cell; leave ample transparent space to the right of the tip. Maintain chunky pixel cells and clear eyes/mouth, same 4:3 landscape sheet 1448×1086 with exactly4×3 equal squares.
visual_review: 은발·파란 눈·흰 보라 복장과 장총이 유지됩니다. 조준, 강력한 단발, 반동과 회수를 확인했습니다. 우측 끝을 자르던 광선을 유한한 수정 탄환으로 재생성해 탄환 끝이 셀 안에서 보입니다.
